# Keep the Engine README Body-first after the split

## Context

Engine `dev@b83ccc52` still carries the deepest Brain/institution explanation: a 52-line / 5.9KB Brain section with the named roster and night-shift mechanics. Brain #186 is the receive-side correction. Engine also retains the retired outward product name four times, including the prominent legacy video block, and its repository map places **You are here** before the Engine link.

## The Problem

Engine remains the organism-level apex and must explain both hemispheres, but it should not be the canonical home for Brain roster/night-shift details after the split. The retired outward name and video create a separate trademark/collision regression. The prefix marker violates the operator's exact map grammar.

## The Architectural Reality

- Engine owns the Body and organization apex; Brain owns deep Agent OS/institution narrative.
- Brain #186 must merge receive-first before Engine removes duplicate roster/night-shift ownership.
- Agent Institution is the outward operator-product name; fleet remains internal subsystem vocabulary per D#17247.
- Engine quickstart, Body architecture, application-engine audience, badges, community and contribution doors remain primary.

## The Fix

Update Engine `README.md` only, after Brain #186 merges:

1. Remove the legacy product-film hero block whose visible title/alt uses the retired outward name; do not relabel an external destination that still carries it.
2. Replace remaining outward retired-name occurrences with Agent Institution while preserving internal fleet vocabulary only where it names the subsystem.
3. Change the Engine map row so the repository link begins the bullet and plain **← You are here** ends the row outside the link.
4. Compress the duplicated deep Brain/institution section: retain a concise organism-level Brain summary and canonical Brain README link, but remove the static roster and night-shift ownership only after #186 lands them.
5. Preserve the apex, Body/Possession story, Engine Quickstart, Engine architecture, platform scale, community and contribution content.

## Contract Ledger Matrix

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Engine Brain summary | Brain #186 + canonical Introduction | Concise parent-level explanation linking the Brain owner | no removal before receive | Engine README | before/after custody matrix |
| product video/name | D#17247 + operator ruling | No retired outward name or legacy-titled video | omit rather than mislabel | Engine README | occurrence/link audit |
| organization map | operator formatting direction | Repository text first; Engine suffix marker outside link | none | Engine README | exact Markdown assertion |

## Decision Record impact

Aligned-with ADR 0018, ADR 0040 and D#17247. No ADR change.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Brain #186 is merged before any Brain roster/night-shift detail is removed from Engine.
- [ ] The retired legacy product-video block is absent; no replacement points at an external artifact with the retired outward title.
- [ ] Retired outward product-name occurrences are zero; Agent Institution is used outwardly and internal fleet vocabulary remains only for actual subsystem references.
- [ ] Every organization-map bullet begins with repository text; Engine alone ends with plain **← You are here** outside the link.
- [ ] Engine retains a concise, correct Brain/Agent OS summary and canonical Brain README door without owning the static roster/night-shift narrative.
- [ ] Organism apex, Body/Possession narrative, Quickstart, Engine architecture, scale, community and contribution doors remain intact.
- [ ] All local Markdown/HTML targets exist and all new/changed public targets resolve.
- [ ] PR evidence names the exact Engine rows removed only because Brain #186 received them.
- [ ] Cross-family identity review completes before merge.

## Out of Scope

Brain README implementation · Agent Institution README · package metadata · Portal/SEO/Introduction · product-film retitling/upload · Engine source/tests/apps · community-link changes.

## Avoided Traps

- Deleting the organization apex or all Brain explanation from Engine.
- Removing institution detail before Brain receives it.
- Relabeling a legacy external video while its destination still exposes the retired name.
- Turning outward naming cleanup into an internal fleet-module rename.

## Premise check before implementation (2026-09-15)

The blocker is cleared: neomjs/neo-agent-brain#186 closed on 2026-08-28, and the Brain README now carries the night shift and the **Agent Institution** naming.

One premise changed after this ticket was filed. On 2026-09-04, at the operator's request, #18334 (PR #18335) **refreshed** five model labels in the Engine README's maintainer roster instead of removing the roster. That was a week after #186 landed.

AC-5 (Engine stops owning the static roster and night-shift narrative) therefore contradicts the latest operator action on that exact table, and shouldn't be implemented from this body alone.

The other acceptance criteria don't depend on it, and still hold on `dev` today:
- the `Agent Fleet Manager` film block at the top of the README;
- the retired outward name in the Institution map row ("the Fleet Manager") and in the Agent Harness paragraph;
- the `**You are here:**` prefix marker in the repository map.

I'm leaving this unassigned. The roster question is for @tobiu.
